data.name: Jackal, Genius Geneticist
data.oracle_text:
Trample
Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value equal to Jackal's power, copy that spell, except the copy isn't legendary. Then put a +1/+1 counter on Jackal. (The copy becomes a token.)
data.flavor_text: For Professor Miles Warren, all any problem needs is a lot of clones and not a lot of ethics.

data.name: Evolution Witness
data.oracle_text:
{1}{G}: Adapt 2. (If this creature has no +1/+1 counters on it, put two +1/+1 counters on it.)
Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
data.flavor_text: She remembers every breakthrough, from the gene's mutation to the new life's propagation.

data.name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
data.oracle_text:
When Rishkar enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
Each creature you control with a counter on it has "{T}: Add {G}."
data.flavor_text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

data.name: Zameck Guildmage
data.oracle_text:
{G}{U}: This turn, each creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
{G}{U}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: Draw a card.

data.name: Llanowar Elves
data.oracle_text: {T}: Add {G}.
data.flavor_text: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.

data.name: Carnage, Crimson Chaos
Vision of Love
data.oracle_text: You may sacrifice an artifact or discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.

data.name: Diresight
data.oracle_text: Surveil 2, then draw two cards. You lose 2 life. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
data.flavor_text: Avatar Roku showed Aang the truth behind Sozin's Comet.

data.name: Soul Warden
data.oracle_text: Whenever another creature enters, you gain 1 life.
data.flavor_text: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

data.name: Ajani's Pridemate
data.oracle_text: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
data.flavor_text: Once rejected by his pride, Ajani is now revered by countless leonin as a healer and, more importantly, a friend.

data.name: Raise the Alarm
data.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
data.flavor_text: The city of Drannith danced to the music of the siege. Four bells meant a breach of the north wall. A horn blast meant all hands to arms. Additional gongs and tones indicated fire, poison, air raids, and more.

data.name: Impact Tremors
data.oracle_text: Whenever a creature you control enters, this enchantment deals 1 damage to each opponent.
data.flavor_text:
"If their ears are to the ground, we will make them bleed!"
—Taklai, Kolaghan warrior

data.name: Dragon Fodder
data.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
data.flavor_text: Gnorl and Vurg knew all too well how much dragons liked to eat goblins, but they had a dream that could not be dampened: they were going to be the first goblins to eat a dragon.

data.name: Good-Fortune Unicorn
data.oracle_text: Whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
data.flavor_text: Catching even a glimpse of one is the start of eight years of good luck.

data.name: Master Biomancer
data.oracle_text: Each other creature you control enters with a number of additional +1/+1 counters on it equal to this creature's power and as a Mutant in addition to its other types.
data.flavor_text: "Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."

data.name: Hardened Scales
data.oracle_text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
data.flavor_text:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

data.name: Sol Ring
data.oracle_text: {T}: Add {C}{C}.
data.flavor_text:
"Actually, 'warp core' is a misnomer. It is technically a generator, but it's not a warp field generator. For some reason, 'deuterium/anti-deuterium intermix reactor' never caught on. Funny, right?"
—Lieutenant junior grade Sam Rutherford

data.name: Unsummon

data.flavor_text:
"The Multiverse is a work in progress. There will need to be revisions."
—The Theorist, Jace Beleren

data.flavor_text: "The stars mark your destiny. May you accept the fate thus divulged."
